changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Define page-level role access control for all 10 virology workflow pages
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO notebook_page_role (id, page_type_id, role_id, active) SELECT NEXTVAL('notebook_page_role_seq'), (SELECT npt.id FROM notebook_page_type npt JOIN notebook_template nt ON npt.template_id = nt.id WHERE nt.template_name = 'Virology Laboratory' AND npt.page_type = 'virology-sample-reception'), sr.id, TRUE FROM system_role sr WHERE sr.name IN ('Virology Lab Technician', 'Virology Microbiologist', 'Virology Manager', 'Virology Principal Investigator', 'Virology Data Manager') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notebook_page_role npr JOIN notebook_page_type npt ON npr.page_type_id = npt.id JOIN notebook_template nt ON npt.template_id = nt.id WHERE nt.template_name = 'Virology Laboratory' AND npt.page_type = 'virology-sample-reception' AND npr.role_id = sr.id );
